hazards.name: Physical Obstructions
hazards.description: Large sign structures and utility poles are placed within the sidewalk area, creating obstacles for pedestrians and narrowing the clear path.

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalks
hazards.description: There are no paved walkways on either side of the road, forcing pedestrians onto uneven dirt or into the travel lane.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the roadway throughout the foreground and midground

hazards.name: Wide Uncontrolled Roadway
hazards.description: The wide, open road design with minimal markings encourages high vehicle speeds without any pedestrian protection.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: Lack of a marked crosswalk at an intersection where pedestrians are present.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image, near the pedestrian.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair and Expansion
interventions.description: Repair the existing sidewalk on the left and widen it to meet modern accessibility standards.

interventions.title: New Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct a new sidewalk on the right side of the street to provide a continuous and safe pedestrian path.

interventions.title: Street Tree Planting
interventions.description: Add street trees in the buffer zone to provide shade and create a vertical sense of enclosure that naturally slows traffic.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks with high-visibility paint and signage to clearly define pedestrian paths.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add curb extensions at potential crossing points to reduce the crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Introduce street trees and a planting buffer to separate the sidewalk from the roadway and provide a psychological narrowing of the street.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a median refuge island to provide a safe waiting area for pedestrians crossing the wide roadway.

interventions.title: Utility Pole Relocation
interventions.description: Relocate the utility pole to the grass strip behind the sidewalk or underground to provide a clear, unobstructed walking path.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer Strip
interventions.description: Install a landscaped buffer or furniture zone between the curb and the sidewalk to increase the physical and psychological distance between pedestrians and vehicles.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair
interventions.description: Repair cracked and uneven sidewalk panels to prevent tripping hazards and improve accessibility.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Infill
interventions.description: Construct a continuous, ADA-compliant sidewalk on the right side of the street to provide a protected path for pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Midblock Crossing
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with high-visibility 'continental' markings and pedestrian warning signs.

interventions.title: Curb Radius Reduction
interventions.description: Tighten the curb radii at driveway entrances to slow turning vehicles and shorten the pedestrian crossing distance.

interventions.title: Driveway Narrowing and Consolidation
interventions.description: Reduce the width of the parking lot entrance using curb extensions to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and slow turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Continuous Sidewalk Treatment
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk material and level across the driveway to clearly signal pedestrian right-of-way to drivers.

interventions.title: Complete Sidewalk Network
interventions.description: Construct a continuous, ADA-compliant sidewalk on the right side of the street to provide a dedicated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Install High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add marked crosswalks with pedestrian signals at the intersection to provide safe and predictable crossing points.

interventions.title: Implement Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Narrow the crossing distance and improve visibility by extending the sidewalk into the parking lane at the intersection.

interventions.title: Roadway Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair the cracked and degraded pavement to improve safety for all road users.

interventions.title: Marked Midblock Crossing
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with appropriate signage to provide a safe crossing point.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer and Widening
interventions.description: Widen the existing sidewalk and add a furniture or planting zone to separate pedestrians from moving traffic.

interventions.title: Lane Markings and Road Diet
interventions.description: Paint clear lane lines and consider narrowing travel lanes to reduce vehicle speeds and provide space for buffers or bike lanes.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway to improve pedestrian comfort and safety.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Resurfacing
interventions.description: Completely replace the cracked concrete with a smooth, continuous, and level surface to ensure safety and accessibility.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation and Curbing
interventions.description: Install curbs and a defined, narrower driveway throat to reduce the distance pedestrians are exposed to vehicles and to slow turning speeds.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffers
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or street trees between the sidewalk and the curb to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer
interventions.description: Install a planting strip or furniture zone between the sidewalk and the curb to increase pedestrian comfort and safety.

interventions.title: Lane Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of travel lanes to encourage slower vehicle speeds and reduce the overall crossing distance.

interventions.title: Midblock Crossing
interventions.description: If pedestrian demand exists, install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with appropriate signage or signals.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or street trees between the sidewalk and the curb to provide a physical and psychological barrier from traffic.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strip
interventions.description: Install a landscaped buffer between the curb and the sidewalk to provide physical separation from traffic and improve the walking environment.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Add lighting specifically oriented toward the sidewalk to improve visibility and security for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Introduce a planting strip or street furniture zone to create physical separation between the walkway and the roadway.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk with high-visibility thermoplastic markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacon (RRFB)
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-activated flashing beacons to alert drivers and increase yielding rates at the mid-block crossing.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planters
interventions.description: Introduce a furniture zone with trees or planters to provide a physical and psychological buffer from traffic.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Clear Zone
interventions.description: Relocate utility and signage infrastructure to the edge of the sidewalk to maintain a continuous, unobstructed walking path.

interventions.title: Pavement Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Repair cracked and uneven sidewalk sections to improve safety and accessibility for all users.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Install continuous, ADA-compliant paved sidewalks on both sides of the street to separate pedestrians from traffic.

interventions.title: Road Diet and Lane Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the effective width of the roadway through lane narrowing or the addition of bike lanes to slow traffic and reduce crossing distances.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Protection
interventions.description: Widen the existing sidewalk and install bollards to prevent vehicles from parking on the walkway.
